serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Fuck it! You only live once!
???: Hey! Stop stealing my trash! Put it down you homeless bastard!
You: Fuck you! You have thrown it out, so what the big deal?! 
???: S-shut up!
Oh man! Good thing it’s nighttime and there’s not many people on the streets.
Some guys screaming at each other at midnight is a daily occurrence here so most people are just trying to sleep it through. 
After all, it would be a pain in the ass if they didn’t get enough sleep before their 12h shift job.
Nevertheless, shouldn’t that guy be happy that I took this part? He could have gotten in trouble for it.
